narrative: Material PL2__M0EBA17C exhibits smooth, high-volume demand (~36,153 units/day) with no detectable trend. The primary risk driver is lead time volatility (CV 0.60, contributing 83.5% of replenishment variance), necessitating a higher safety stock (58,305) than the current SAP setting (43,457). The EOQ analysis reveals the current order quantity (MOQ = 40,560) is far below the economic optimum, causing excessive ordering frequency and cost. Adopting the recommended (r,Q) policy with Q=356,666 and r=112,513 reduces total annual inventory cost by $13,088 (74.7%) while maintaining the 95% service level target.
